Public Wi-Fi networks can be monitored by attackers. Never access your work email, financial applications, or any system with sensitive information over public Wi-Fi. Use your mobile data instead.
"Accept All Cookies" may enable extensive tracking of your browsing behaviour across the internet. Choose "Manage Preferences" or "Reject Non-Essential" where possible. Your data is worth protecting.
